paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +1.53% on average, with Dow Jones strongest (+3.03%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-0.33%). Brent crude changed -8.68% to 94.61. Gold changed +3.31% to 4,070.7. Bitcoin changed +3.67% to 80,185.5781. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.894%, a relative move of -1.17%. Among the firms tracked, Newmont (+9.90%) and Gold Miners (ETF) (+9.01%) moved the most.
